tooltips.isDefault: If checked, this funnel will be automatically selected for new opportunities within the team
tooltips.followupsEnabled: When disabled, opportunities in this funnel never run automated follow-ups: the AI does not arm new opportunities with a follow-up loop, scheduled follow-ups stop firing, and opportunities currently in 'Follow-up Active' are reset to 'Action Needed' the moment you disable it. The AI can still create and update opportunities in this funnel normally.
